description: Quantcast Measure pixels on pixel.quantserve.com/pixel, whose p-code rides as matrix parameter a.

params.name: a
params.description: It is the Quantcast p-code. Quantcast documents Measure tag calls with `a=p-` plus that identifier.
params.fix_hint: Set `a` to the p-code from the Quantcast account, starting with `p-`.

params.name: labels
params.description: It is the audience segment or event label. Quantcast documents Measure tag calls with labels=_fp.event. plus the segment name.
params.fix_hint: Set labels to the Event Manager segment, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: orderid
params.description: It is the order identifier on a purchase confirmation. Quantcast documents orderid on the Measure tag call.
params.fix_hint: Set orderid to the order ID, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: revenue
params.description: It is the order value. Quantcast documents revenue as a number on the Measure tag call.
params.fix_hint: Set revenue to a number such as 100, with no currency symbol.

params.name: url
params.description: It is the page URL the tag fired on. Quantcast documents url on the Measure tag call.
params.fix_hint: Set url to the absolute page URL, encoded on the tag.
